newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Skanska says gets $380 mln U.S. motorway contract.
newsitem.headline: Skanska says gets $380 mln U.S. motorway contract.

text.p: Swedish construction firm Skanska said on Tuesday that it had won a $380 million motorway contract in the U.S. of which is American unit, Slattery, would account for 35 percent.
Skanska landed the contract, which concerns the gigantic highway extension Central Artery in Boston, together with J.F. White and Perini Corp, the company said in a statement.
"The project includes cut-and-cover tunnels for one kilometre, underground highways with nine lanes and 10 temporary bridges between North Street and Chardon Street in central Boston," Skanska said.
This is the third contract for Slattery on the $8-10 billion redevelopment of Boston's inner city highway system and its total order value on the project amounts to $935 million.
